description: MCP server for Rustpad, the self-hosted collaborative text editor
name: io.github.ni-c/rustpad-mcp

environmentVariables.description: Base URL of the Rustpad instance, e.g. https://rustpad.example.net
environmentVariables.name: RUSTPAD_URL

environmentVariables.description: Exactly 'true' registers only the 3 read tools
environmentVariables.name: RUSTPAD_READ_ONLY

environmentVariables.description: Exactly 'true' accepts a self-signed certificate, scoped to this connection
environmentVariables.name: RUSTPAD_INSECURE_TLS

environmentVariables.description: Comma-separated tool names or list_* prefixes to register; 'essential' selects a curated preset (default: all tools)
environmentVariables.name: RUSTPAD_ALLOW_TOOLS

environmentVariables.description: Comma-separated tool names or list_* prefixes to remove from whatever RUSTPAD_ALLOW_TOOLS left
environmentVariables.name: RUSTPAD_DENY_TOOLS

title: Rustpad MCP Server
